title: XMH: Explainable Metaheuristics via Exact-Coalition Operator-Level Shapley Value Attribution
description: Python framework for exact Shapley value attribution at the operator level in metaheuristic algorithms. Includes instrumented implementations of DE, GA, PSO, CMA-ES, SHADE and JADE, four attribution methods, and the raw per-run coalition values behind every quantitative claim of the manuscript. Version 1.3.0 adds two experiments that test the two design choices most likely to have produced the paper's headline findings: SHADE's parameter-adaptation result at the memory size its specification uses, and the dimensional trends at constant evaluation budget per dimension.
